Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for assay CHEMBL647319. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, and join compound_structures as an inner join. Filter where standard_value is not null, standard_relation is not null, and standard_relation equals '='. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
